versions.changelog:
**Major update: All internal scripts and supporting code have been removed.**

- Removed 122 script and vendor files from the skill, including all posting, conversion, and environment check scripts.
- No runtime logic is provided in this version; only the documentation and metadata remain.
- All WeChat Official Account posting features (browser, API, markdown conversion, account management) are no longer present in this version.
- The SKILL.md documentation is unchanged and still describes multi-account support and setup, but no scripts are included to implement these features.

- Major update: Adds robust multi-account and per-account settings support for publishing to multiple WeChat Official Accounts.
- EXTEND.md now supports multiple accounts with individual credentials, Chrome profiles, and publishing preferences.
- Improved config resolution, with clear fallbacks across CLI, frontmatter, account, and global defaults.
- Account selection logic enables auto-selection, prompts, and CLI override for multi-account setups.
- Supports both API-based and browser-based publishing methods, configurable per account.
- Updated documentation for .env variable handling and enhanced theme/color configuration options.
